_meta._comment: Danger Ghost - Niteroi isometric overworld grid. Chunk (1,0), pilot chunk generated to validate seam-stitching against chunk (0,0). Real-world street geometry sourced from OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
_meta.osm_attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, data available under the Open Database License (ODbL) - https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

real_world_reference.note: Query center for this chunk was derived analytically from the fixed city origin (data/niteroi_overworld_grid.json chunk 0,0's real_world_reference.origin_lat/origin_lon), NOT re-identified from a landmark. chunkX=1, chunkY=0, chunkOriginGlobalCol=85, chunkOriginGlobalRow=0.

data_source.query_purpose: Fetch every OSM way tagged highway=* within 600m of this chunk's computed center point, used to rasterize the walkable street network.
data_source.extraction_note: Query executed for real against the live Overpass API during this session; no coordinates in this file are invented. Raw response cached to disk before rasterization.

projection.method: local equirectangular (flat-earth approximation), adequate at this scale (<1km)
projection.formula_y_south_meters: y = (chunk_query_center_lat - lat) * meters_per_degree_latitude   // NOTE: y is SOUTH-positive, matching row-major grid order (row 0 = north)

grid.query_radius_rationale: 600m radius queried vs 420m half-extent used in the final square grid - same margin as chunk (0,0), giving slack to adjust the seam against neighbouring chunks without re-querying.
grid.row_order: row 0 = northernmost row; row increases southward
grid.col_order: col 0 = westernmost column; col increases eastward
grid.cell_to_local_meters: x_m = (col - half_extent_tiles) * tile_size_m ; y_m = (row - half_extent_tiles) * tile_size_m
grid.cell_to_latlon: combine cell_to_local_meters with projection.inverse_formula_lat/lon above (relative to THIS chunk's chunk_query_center_lat/lon)
grid.encoding: grid.rows is an array of DIM strings, each DIM characters long, one character per cell per the legend above. rows[row][col]. No landmark ('L') cells - POIs are data-driven (Estagio 2), not rasterized into pilot chunks.

classification_method.street: A cell is 'street' if its center lies within halfwidth_by_highway_type meters of some OSM way tagged highway=*, measured as point-to-segment distance on the projected polyline (halfwidths per tools/build-overworld-grid.js HALFWIDTH_M, ~1.3x the original pass), THEN a deterministic diagonal-gap-closing pass (closeDiagonalGaps) promotes the orthogonal bridge cell closer to a real way wherever two street cells only touched corner-to-corner - see the root-cause note at the top of tools/build-overworld-grid.js. Regenerated 2026-09-03T13:36:17.504Z after the Estagio 5 finding of 151 disconnected 4-connected components (only 19 walkable cells near the tower).
classification_method.block: Default classification for every cell not reached by a street buffer. Same simplification as chunk (0,0): no separate OSM building-footprint query was run (block == 'not street').

connectivity_closing_pass.note: Diagonal-only-adjacent street cells (8-connected but not 4-connected, the only movement the game allows) get bridged by promoting whichever orthogonal neighbor cell is geometrically closest to a real OSM way. Runs to a fixed point (no more corner-only touches remain).

caveats: Regenerado em 2026-09-03T13:33:30.561Z: halfwidths aumentados (~1.3x) + fechamento de gap diagonal (ver tools/build-overworld-grid.js) para eliminar fragmentacao 4-conectada. Isto muda QUAIS celulas sao rua vs quarteirao perto de bordas antes ambiguas; nenhuma coordenada OSM foi inventada, so a regra de rasterizacao.
